title: The guard refuses `git checkout -B` or `switch -C` of a branch another worktree holds
why: Lane fix-check-after-notes-commit saw it twice on Nov 7 (record commit 9b2a11b9e, builder commit 391d4deea). Three worktrees held one branch through `git checkout -B <branch>`. A commit from one carried a stale index and undid another worktree's pushed work. The harm is a silent undo of pushed code.
note: Remedy line: `git checkout --detach origin/<branch>`, then `git push origin HEAD:<branch>`. Overlaps three steps in the same guard home: checkout-b-current-branch (the -B of the current branch, lane session_013NEJL1N3YkCMouc1pELXyu), agent-push-moves-held-branch (a push to a held branch) and worktree-unique-branch. The coordinator's lane two-worktrees-one-branch may also cover it. The coordinator assigns the lane. Done check: a red test on -B of a branch that another worktree holds.
